description: This file defines the FieldPreprocess class responsible for preprocessing field variables and form elements in Drupal's rendering system, including handling multiple values and table reordering.

classes.name: FieldPreprocess
classes.description: Class responsible for preprocessing field variables and form elements for rendering in Drupal.

methods.name: preprocessField
methods.description: Prepares variables for field templates, setting entity type, field name, type, label, and handling attributes and items.

methods.name: preprocessFieldMultipleValueForm
methods.description: Prepares variables for multiple value form templates, including creating sortable tables with drag-and-drop reordering.
